Doomersion (formerly Doomlingo) lets you learn languages by doomsrolling! Watch TikToks in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and as you scroll, they get a little bit harder.
Gen-Z doomscrolls 2.5-3 hours a day, and if we bake immersion into that by only showing them viral videos in another language that are matched to their level, we can make the optimal language learning method addictive for people. Hence the name, doomersion.
Doomersion - Learn Languages by Doomscrolling
See original launch post
Doomersion lets you learn languages by doomscrolling in them! It shows you short videos in your target language that are exactly matched to your level, and then as you scroll they get progressively harder.
https://youtube.com/shorts/x22sJ7nHVHw
There’s no language learning app that’s fun enough to spend hours a day on while still being educational. Gen Z doomscrolls an average of 2.5-3 hours a day.
As it turns out, the optimal strategy for language learning is immersion with spaced repetition, and by baking immersion into the doomscrolling algorithm, Doomersion makes it fun to learn languages.
I’d really appreciate it if you guys could download Doomersion and give it a try!
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/doomersion/id6753957215
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mostafaafr.doomlingo
Hear from the founders
Combine it with what Gen-Z DOES want to do on a daily basis: doomscrolling. And that’s how doomersion was born!

Doomersion operates within the educational technology sector and provides a mobile application with videos in various languages. These videos are designed for different proficiency levels and include clickable explainer subtitles to assist in learning. The company's target audience consists of individuals who are learning new languages.
It was founded in 2025 and is based in San Francisco, California.
Claude's Corner: Doomersion — TikTok for Language Learners
May 28, 2026
Doomersion (YC W2026) turns doomscrolling into language learning — a TikTok-style feed of level-matched foreign language videos with interactive subtitles and passive spaced repetition. We break down how it works technically and how hard it is to clone.
May 28 at 11:20 AM 9 min read TL;DR Doomersion (YC W2026) turns doomscrolling into language learning with a TikTok-style feed of level-matched foreign language videos. It uses ASR with forced alignment for interactive subtitles and a passive spaced repetition system. The moat is the curated content corpus and engagement data, not the tech stack.
The startup, backed by Y Combinator in the W2026 batch, asks a simple question: if Gen Z is going to spend 2.5 to 3 hours a day staring at short videos anyway, why not make those videos teach them Japanese? It's less a language learning app than a hostile takeover of your brain's dopamine loop — and the early numbers suggest it's working.

Doomersion is an educational software company that developed a language learning platform to teach new languages through short-form videos.
Founded in 2025 by Mostafa Afr, the San Francisco-based startup aims to make language acquisition more intuitive and interactive. The company is a Y Combinator accelerator participant and secured $500K in an accelerator funding round on March 26, 2026.
It serves as an alternative to traditional social media scrolling, providing an educational benefit. The company generates revenue through its platform, which is currently in a 'Generating Revenue' stage, and offers premium services.
